name: etherpk-terminal
title: EtherPK Terminal
description: In the mould of Hugo's Terminal: monospace, dark, one ink in shades, a block logo with a blinking cursor, underlined titles and framed boxes.

includes.name: head
includes.description: Extra markup inside <head>: analytics, fonts, meta tags. Raw HTML in the page body.

includes.name: logo
includes.description: The mark before the site title in the header's prompt box: an image or inline SVG. Replaces the EtherPK icon.

includes.name: header
includes.description: The site header. Replaces the theme's prompt-style logo, menu and search box.

includes.name: before-content
includes.description: Rendered above every page's content: a banner, a notice.

includes.name: after-content
includes.description: Rendered below every page's content, above the linked references: an author bio, a comments widget.

includes.name: scripts
includes.description: Scripts before </body>, added after the theme's own (search): analytics, a widget. Raw HTML in the page body.

includes.name: styles
includes.description: CSS appended after the theme's stylesheet: the page's first css fence.
